name: Adelaide
text: Adelaide is the practical gateway for a South Australian wine, coast and wildlife itinerary: it works as the arrival base, urban food-and-market stop, and launch point for Barossa, McLaren Vale, the Fleurieu Peninsula, Kangaroo Island and the Adelaide Hills.

name: Barossa
text: Barossa is one of South Australia's signature wine regions and is best treated as a dedicated cellar-door day or overnight stop rather than a quick add-on. It supports wine-tasting itineraries that need regional pacing, meal planning and designated-driver or private-transfer logic.

name: McLaren Vale
text: McLaren Vale sits within the Fleurieu Peninsula travel pattern and pairs naturally with coastal scenery, long lunches, cellar doors and relaxed self-drive pacing. It is a strong fit for South Australian wine itineraries that also include Victor Harbor or the coast.

name: Victor Harbor Whale Watching
text: Victor Harbor is a key South Australian whale-watching base on the Fleurieu Peninsula. Whale-watching recommendations should be treated as seasonal and weather-dependent, with the itinerary preserving flexibility and using current visitor information before locking the day.

name: Kangaroo Island
text: Kangaroo Island adds wildlife, coast and national-park depth to a South Australian itinerary, but it needs explicit access planning. Ferry or flight timing, car logistics, buffer time and weather disruption risk should be checked before finalising the route.

name: Kangaroo Island ferry access
text: Kangaroo Island ferry access is an operational constraint, not just a sightseeing note. A strong itinerary should preserve check-in time, vehicle or passenger logistics, and buffer time before and after the crossing.

name: Adelaide Hills
text: The Adelaide Hills work well as a softer final leg for a South Australian itinerary, combining cool-climate food and wine, village stays, gardens and an easy return to Adelaide. It can reduce end-of-trip driving pressure after Kangaroo Island or the Fleurieu coast.

name: Seal Bay
text: Seal Bay is a Kangaroo Island wildlife experience that should be planned with official park guidance and appropriate timing. Wildlife activities need visitor-safety, access and weather context rather than being treated as generic sightseeing.
